title: Questions
summary: Buyers ask about your birds on the product page. Your answer is public, so every buyer can read it.

sections.title: What is this page?
sections.intro: On every product page, buyers can ask a question to the seller before they buy. For example: "How old is the bird?", "Is it vaccinated?" or "Can I see the parents?". This page lists those questions for your products. You write the answers here.

blocks.title: In simple words
items: The question and your answer show on the product page, for everyone to read.
The buyer's name is hidden a little, for example "Rahim K.".
You only see questions about your own products.
Nobody can answer for you. Admins do not answer for a seller.

sections.title: Why does it matter to you?

items: A quick, clear answer can turn a worried buyer into a customer.
You answer one time and many buyers read it. You do not need to repeat the same thing in messages.
Good answers show you know your birds. This builds trust in your shop.
Buyers who find the answer on the page buy with fewer doubts, so you get fewer returns and fewer arguments.

sections.title: When will you see a question?

blocks.title: How a question reaches you
steps: A signed-in buyer opens your product page.
They type a question in "Questions and answers". It must be between 10 and 1000 characters.
The question appears in "Questions" with "Needs your answer".
A number appears on the dashboard box "Questions to answer" and on the bell.

blocks.title: Rules for buyers
items: A buyer must sign in to ask.
A buyer can have at most 3 questions waiting for an answer on the same product. This stops spam.

items.means: Nobody answered yet. Do these first.
You already answered. You can still change the answer.

blocks.title: Also on this page
items: Use the search box to find a question or a product name.
Each question shows which product it is about, and what the buyer is asking.

blocks.title: Step by step
steps: Read "What the buyer is asking". Look at which product it is for.
Click in the answer box. It says: "Write a clear answer. Everyone who visits the product page can read it."
Type your answer. It must be between 2 and 2000 characters.
The answer shows on the product page at once.

blocks.text: Everyone can read your answer, not only the buyer. Do not write phone numbers, home addresses or private details.

blocks.title: How to
steps: Open the "Answered" tab and find the question.
Fix the words, then press "Save the new answer".
The product page shows the new answer.

blocks.text: Use this when a fact changes, for example when the bird is sold or you got the vaccine date wrong.

sections.title: How to write a good answer

items: Answer the question first, in the first sentence. Example: "Yes, it is vaccinated."
Add one useful fact. Example: "The vaccine was given on 10 October."
Use short, plain words. Not everyone knows pigeon terms.
Be honest. A wrong answer causes a return and a bad review.
Be polite, even if the question seems silly.
If the answer is in the product details, say it again anyway. A buyer who asked did not find it.

blocks.title: An example
steps: Question: "How old is this bird and can it fly far?"
Good answer: "It is 8 months old. It has flown 50 km in training. I can send a video if you message me."

items: An admin can hide a question that breaks the rules, for example rude words.
A hidden question is not shown to buyers or to you, and you cannot answer it.
An admin can bring it back.
You cannot delete questions. Deleting is switched off.

items.q: Do I have to answer every question?
items.a: No, but you should. An unanswered question looks like you are not interested.

items.q: Can the buyer see my answer only?
items.a: No. Every visitor of the product page can read the question and the answer.

items.q: A question has bad words. What do I do?
items.a: Do not answer it. Tell the admin team, who can hide it.

items.q: Can I answer if my account is suspended?
items.a: No. You can read questions, but only an active seller can answer.

items.q: Is this the same as a price offer?
items.a: No. A question is a public chat about the product. A price offer is a private deal about the price between you and one buyer.
